request.query: sum of first n natural numbers times two equals n times n minus one

items.name: Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i) * 2 = n * (n - 1)

items.name: Finset.sum_range_id
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i = n * (n - 1) / 2

items.name: Nat.geomSum_eq
items.type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 2 ≤ m → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, m ^ k = (m ^ n - 1) / (m - 1)
